notes.title: hack_me 3 announce!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 
I've got great news for you: I'm working on the next chapter - hack_me 3!
Demo is already available on Steam, you can add it to your wishlists, it will contains 1st episode of the game for free ?heart_me?
Release date of the Demo - approx. July 2019.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/602900/hack_me_3/

notes.title: The upcoming release and its features
notes.content:
Friends, we are glad to inform you that the release of the game is scheduled for 8 a.m. PST ːsteamhappyː

At the moment the game will be available on Windows and MacOS, it is planned to add support for Linux.

In terms of gameplay in the game will be 10 game days out of 30, but the remaining levels are already ready and only need polishing. Also, the main task of accessing early access is to fix most of the bugs in the game, with which you can help ːheart_meː

Be sure to leave your recommendations and bug reports in Steam discussions.
